# Nishatt Attendance Buddy

> Smart attendance tracker and timetable companion for university and college students.

Nishatt Attendance Buddy helps students stay above required attendance thresholds (such as the 75% minimum attendance rule), optimize schedules, track daily lectures, and plan excused leaves with real-time statistics.

## Core Capabilities

- **Daily Attendance Logging**: One-tap marking for present, absent, or cancelled lecture slots.
- **75% Attendance Planner**: Real-time calculation of safe leaves and classes needed to reach target percentage.
- **Weekly Timetable Management**: Interactive schedule builder with timetable sharing codes and image upload OCR extraction.
- **Visual Analytics**: Interactive attendance calendars, subject-wise trends, and weekly summaries.
- **Cross-Platform**: Responsive Web application with progressive Capacitor support for iOS and Android.
- **Privacy & Security**: Secure user authentication and encrypted persistence via Supabase.

## Public Endpoints & Routes

- `/`: Student Dashboard, schedule view, subject manager, and analytics reports.
- `/auth`: Student portal authentication (Sign in, Sign up, Password recovery).
- `/privacy`: Data handling and student privacy disclosures.
- `/terms`: Terms of service and usage guidelines.
- `/sitemap.xml`: XML sitemap for indexing search engines.

## Technical Architecture

- **Frontend**: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui components, Framer Motion animations.
- **State & Data**: TanStack Query, Supabase client with real-time synchronization.
- **Branding**: Nishatt Attendance Buddy (https://attendance.nishatt.com).
